subject: Kickoff: Pre-contract security gate for vendor setup — BlueHaven Therapeutics
messages:
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
From: Emma Thompson <emma.thompson@bluehavenrx.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@bluehavenrx.com, rajiv.sinha@bluehavenrx.com
Subject: Vendor security intake & PO steps for Redwood (BlueHaven)

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. BlueHaven is moving Redwood forward in our vendor process for the evaluation pilot. Before Legal prepares a final PO, Procurement needs our security and procurement prerequisites queued up so we can get an internal approval.

Could you share the following items as attachments (prefer PDF where possible):
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest, redacted allowed)
- ISO 27001 certificate and scope
- A penetration test attestation or summary + remediation status
- Vendor onboarding / W9 / bank details form (we can provide a template if easier)
- Point of contact for invoicing and a sample invoice

Also: what is the typical lead time from PO to start-of-service for a reserved capacity or hosted contract? We aim to align procurement and legal.

Appreciate a confirmation of receipt and an ETA for the docs.

Best,
Emma Thompson
Senior Procurement Manager
BlueHaven Therapeutics
emma.thompson@bluehavenrx.com
+1 (415) 555-0182
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:38:00 -0700
From: olga.petrov@redwood.com
To: Emma Thompson <emma.thompson@bluehavenrx.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Subject: Re: Vendor security intake & PO steps for Redwood (BlueHaven)

Emma — thanks for the clear checklist. We'll get this stood up today. Quick notes:
- We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and the current ISO 27001 certificate in PDF.
- We have a consolidated pen test attestation (summary + date + MRA) we can attach; if you need full findings we usually use an NDA/secure share.
- I'll attach our standard vendor onboarding form and sample invoice.
- Typical PO-to-service timelines: hosted API (self-serve) can start immediately; contract + PO for a dedicated setup is typically 2–3 weeks after PO depending on legal turnaround and region; if BlueHaven needs on-prem or private VPC that can be longer (4–6 weeks) — we can confirm once we understand the scope.

I'll loop in Marcus (security) and Laura (finance/procurement lead) to assemble the PDFs and confirm the bank details format. ETA for attachments: <= 48 hours.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
From: marcus.lin@redwood.com
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, Emma Thompson <emma.thompson@bluehavenrx.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Subject: Re: Vendor security intake & PO steps for Redwood (BlueHaven)

Emma / Olga — thanks for the heads up. Per your request, we are attaching a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and our ISO 27001 certificate. For pen testing we maintain an attestation document that summarizes scope, test vendor, and remediation status — attaching that as well.

A few clarifying items from Security:
- SOC 2 redactions: we remove customer names and any vendor-signed NDAs; if BlueHaven requires unredacted materials we will need an executed NDA and a secure file transfer.
- ISO scope: the ISO cert covers our hosted control plane and inference runtime services; if BlueHaven requires specific on-prem scope mapping, we can provide a short control matrix.
- Pen test attestation: the last external pen test was 2026-06-12, no critical findings; remediation work for two medium findings was completed 2026-07-01.

I'll attach: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_Redacted.pdf, Redwood_ISO27001_Certificate.pdf, PenTest_Attestation_2026.pdf.

Marcus Lin
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 08:14:00 -0700
From: olga.petrov@redwood.com
To: Emma Thompson <emma.thompson@bluehavenrx.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Subject: Re: Vendor security intake & PO steps for Redwood (BlueHaven)

Emma — attaching the following for BlueHaven procurement intake (PDFs attached):
1) Redwood_SOC2_Type2_Redacted.pdf (attachment)
2) Redwood_ISO27001_Certificate.pdf (attachment)
3) PenTest_Attestation_2026.pdf (attachment)
4) Vendor_Onboarding_Form_BlueHaven.pdf (attachment) — partially filled; please complete the "Billing/PO instructions" section and return.
5) Sample_Invoice_Redwood.pdf (attachment) — shows required invoice fields and remit address.

Next steps from our side:
- Once BlueHaven confirms the PO number and signs the vendor form, Finance will issue tax/merchant verification and then we can route for provisioning.
- If you need a formal SOC 2 bridge letter or an engineer Q&A, Marcus can provide a short call or a written Q&A.

Let me know if you want us to open a shared secure folder for unredacted artifacts (NDA required).

Thanks,
Olga
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0700
From: Rajiv Sinha <rajiv.sinha@bluehavenrx.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: Emma Thompson <emma.thompson@bluehavenrx.com>, procurement@bluehavenrx.com
Subject: Re: Vendor security intake & PO steps for Redwood (BlueHaven)

Olga — thanks for the quick turnaround and the docs. A couple of items from Procurement/Legal:
- Please confirm Redwood's vendor legal name and EIN for the PO.
- We need a short confirmation that Redwood will not process PHI on BlueHaven's behalf for this pilot (we are currently presuming Redwood will not host PHI). If Redwood may process PHI, we need a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) and additional scoping.
- Can you provide bank wiring details or an ACH remit template?

Also: BlueHaven requires the pen test attestation + SOC 2 to be valid within the last 12 months at contract execution. The SOC 2 you provided is dated 2025 (issue); can Marcus confirm the reporting period covered by the SOC 2?

If everything is in order we'll initiate the internal PO and send the PO number back to you. ETA from our side: aim to issue PO by 10/09 if we get the legal name/EIN and confirmation on PHI handling.

Regards,
Rajiv Sinha
Procurement Lead
BlueHaven Therapeutics
Date: Fri, 08 Oct 2026 15:48:00 -0700
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Rajiv Sinha <rajiv.sinha@bluehavenrx.com>, Emma Thompson <emma.thompson@bluehavenrx.com>
Cc: olga.petrov@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Subject: Re: Vendor security intake & PO steps for Redwood (BlueHaven)

Hi Rajiv — quick answers to your checklist so you can proceed: 
- Legal name / EIN: Redwood Inference, Inc. / EIN: 12-3456789
- PHI handling: For the planned evaluation pilot, Redwood will NOT process PHI on BlueHaven's behalf. If that changes, we will execute a DPA.
- SOC 2 reporting period: SOC 2 Type II report covers 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31 (Marcus can confirm but that is the covered period).
- Banking: Attached is our remit details in the onboarding form (Vendor_Onboarding_Form_BlueHaven.pdf). We can also provide a bank letter on request.

We are ready to accept a standard PO. Please send the PO number and any required contract redlines to legal@redwood.com and we will route immediately. 

If helpful, I've included a DocuSign link for a simple PO acknowledgement to speed the process: https://docusign.com/r/abc123-bluehaven-po

Thanks — looking forward to working together.

Laura Bennett
